name: Sandugo
description: A blood compact: leaders sealed friendship by mixing drops of their blood in a drink, binding their peoples as kin and allies.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)

lore.en: The sandugo was a blood compact. Two leaders mixed drops of their blood in a drink and shared it. This made their peoples kin and allies, bound to help each other. Spanish accounts record such compacts with visiting captains in the 1500s.
lore.fil: Ang sandugo ay isang kasunduan sa dugo. Hinahalo ng dalawang pinuno ang patak ng kanilang dugo sa inumin at pinagsasaluhan ito. Ginagawa nitong magkamag-anak at magkakampi ang kanilang mga tao. Naitala ng mga Espanyol ang ganitong kasunduan sa mga dumadalaw na kapitan noong 1500s.

inGame.en: A diplomacy path in the Rehiyon: a blood compact makes a neighbor your ally.
inGame.fil: Isang landas ng diplomasya sa Rehiyon: ginagawang kakampi ng sandugo ang isang kapitbahay.

hint.en: Bind a neighbor to you as kin.
